data.name: Johan
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Yohanan', meaning 'God is gracious'. In the New Testament, John the Baptist and John the Apostle are bearers of this name.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the grace and mercy of God.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with the life path number 9 are natural leaders, humanitarians, and teachers.
data.cultural_impact: The name Johan has been popular globally due to the significant figures associated with the name in the Christian faith. It has been used in various European cultures, particularly in Northern Europe, and has been a common name in Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Finland.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Johan carries a powerful spiritual significance rooted in the biblical figure John the Baptist, who prepared the way for Jesus Christ and baptized Him in the river Jordan. The name also symbolizes the virtues of love, faith, and grace as espoused by John the Apostle, one of Jesus' twelve disciples who is revered for his writings in the New Testament. The name Johan thus serves as a constant reminder of the grace of God and the divine promise of salvation.
